$comment: Effort mapping for the OMP provider 'zcode' (GLM-5.3 / GLM-5.3-Flash) via local zcode-proxy v4.6.4 (commit 9a5cebe) to the ZCode start-plan gateway. Verified live on 2026-09-12/13.

provider.access: zcode start-plan (same account/quota as the ZCode desktop app)

effortWireMapping.budgetOwner: OMP (anthropic-budget-effort mode; proxy leaves anthropic bodies untouched except mandated start-plan system blocks + cache_control)
effortWireMapping.budgetSource: OMP built-in per-level thinking budget table (Rne: low 4096/high 16384/max 32768 observed as 2048/16384/32768 on the wire for this model class)
effortWireMapping.deviationNote: The ZCode desktop bundle (per TriDefender/zcode-api reasoning.ts) pairs effort low/high/max with budgets 8000/16000/32000. OMP is the single budget owner on the anthropic passthrough path; its paired budgets are monotonic, distinct and above the gateway floor (1024). Deviation documented, accepted; upstream accepted all three levels (HTTP 200).

normalizationRules.off: normalized by OMP to the lowest supported level (low) with thinking still enabled — GLM-5.3 cannot disable reasoning (vendor docs); never displays 'off' while reasoning continues: OMP records/normalizes the level before display
normalizationRules.xhigh: normalized down to high (verified on the wire: budget 16384)
normalizationRules.unknown: rejected by OMP for models with declared efforts (error: 'Thinking effort X is not supported by zcode/glm-5.3...')

verification.method: local mock upstream capture of OMP wire payloads (all levels) + zcode-proxy ZCODE_DUMP_UPSTREAM capture of the final upstream request (flash low/high/max) + live HTTP 200 responses
evidenceFiles: logs/upstream-dump.jsonl (final upstream bodies with output_config.effort + thinking.budget_tokens)

status.glm-5.3: wire fields verified at the proxy boundary; live completion pending quota reset (daily GLM-5.3 bucket was 0/3,000,000 tokens at test time, resets 2026-09-13T15:59:59Z). Run tests/verify-glm53.mjs after reset.
